summary: This document records the Iceberg Spark integration updates, covering new features such as DSv2 validation, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, and runtime filtering improvements, along with bug fixes for ORC variant handling and vectorized reads. Current Iceberg UDF spec treats the deterministic flag as a weak hint, leading to ambiguity and potential inconsistencies in checks, indexes, and derived columns. The discussion centers on whether Iceberg V4 should cease writing new ORC and Avro data files due to missing features and limited upstream development, while still supporting them for reading to maintain backward compatibility. Neelesh proposes moving the default Iceberg table format from version 2 to 3, noting that Java and Go already support most of v3 while PyIceberg and Rust lag behind.
